config.label: Base URL of a running OPA server
config.description: Base URL of a running OPA server. Required only for opa_* runtime tools, not for rego_* language tools.

config.label: Bearer token for OPA running with --authentication=token
config.description: Bearer token for OPA running with --authentication=token.

config.label: Path to the opa binary
config.description: Path to the opa binary. Defaults to 'opa' on PATH.

config.label: Path to the regal binary (optional; used by rego_lint, rego_security_audit and rego_fix)
config.description: Path to the regal binary (optional; used by rego_lint, rego_security_audit and rego_fix). Defaults to 'regal' on PATH.

config.label: Path to the conftest binary (optional, used by conftest_* tools)
config.description: Path to the conftest binary (optional, used by conftest_* tools). Defaults to 'conftest' on PATH.

config.label: Comma-separated list of root directories tools may read/write
config.description: Comma-separated list of root directories tools may read/write. When unset, file-based tools refuse to access the disk.

config.label: GitHub personal access token with the "gist" scope
config.description: GitHub personal access token with the "gist" scope. Required only for rego_playground_share.
